viewAs.buttonSub: See the menu the way someone with certain Discord roles sees it – like "View server as role" in Discord.
viewAs.title: View as role
viewAs.intro: Pick one or more roles. The menu then shows exactly what a member with these roles sees and may do – base access included. Your own rights stay as they are; the bar at the top takes you back at any time.
viewAs.empty: No roles found – is the bot connected to the server?
viewAs.configuredSub: Areas are unlocked for this role.
viewAs.noneSub: Nothing is set for this role – it only gets the base access.
viewAs.baseOnly: No role picked: view with only the base access every signed-in account has.
viewAs.bannerSub: This is the menu for a member with these roles. Actions run under your name, but only with these roles' rights. Ends by itself after 12 hours at the latest.
